explanation: The regex identifies new log entries by two distinct patterns: either a line starting with a timestamp in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS,ms' (e.g., '2015-10-18 18:05:28,570'), OR a line starting with a Java-style class name followed by a colon (e.g., 'java.net.NoRouteToHostException:'), provided it is NOT preceded by 'Caused by:'. This ensures that actual exception starts are captured as new entries, while stack trace lines (starting with '\tat ', 'Caused by: ', or '... \d+ more') are correctly treated as continuations.
